live_price_source: Yahoo Finance auto-adjusted close snapshot through 2026-07-13
live_price_basis: Yahoo Finance auto-adjusted daily closes, captured point in time
completed_week_rule: Friday-labeled bars at or before as_of whose Friday is present in the source; conservative on Friday market holidays
technical_basis_warning: weekly states use Yahoo auto-adjusted total-return closes and may differ from TradingView raw-close indicators around distributions

authority: research evidence pack; no production signal or portfolio authority
